{
  "name": "proxy",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "An HTTPS debugging proxy inside Claude Code: intercepts browser, iOS and Android traffic with its own CA, setup guides, a filterable request list and tools for Claude.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Legostin Vyacheslav",
    "url": "https://github.com/legostin"
  },
  "homepage": "https://legostin.github.io/claude-code-proxy/",
  "repository": "https://github.com/legostin/claude-code-proxy",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "android",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "debugging",
    "https-proxy",
    "ios",
    "mitm",
    "mock-server",
    "network",
    "proxy",
    "proxyman-alternative",
    "rewrite-rules"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "port": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Port",
      "description": "The port the proxy listens on.",
      "default": 8899
    },
    "listen": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Listen on",
      "description": "local: this Mac only (browser, simulators, Android emulator). lan: also phones on the same network.",
      "options": [
        "local",
        "lan"
      ],
      "default": "local"
    },
    "noDecrypt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hosts not to decrypt",
      "description": "Comma-separated hosts tunnelled untouched (pinned services); *.example.com covers subdomains.",
      "default": "*.apple.com,*.icloud.com,*.mzstatic.com,*.apple-cloudkit.com"
    },
    "maxFlows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Requests kept",
      "description": "How many of the latest requests the list keeps.",
      "default": 2000
    },
    "node": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Node executable",
      "description": "The node binary that runs the proxy (18 or newer).",
      "default": "node"
    }
  }
}
files.types/index.d.ts:
export type ProxyFlow = {
  id: number
  ts: number
  kind: 'http' | 'ws' | 'tunnel'
  method: string
  scheme: 'http' | 'https'
  host: string
  port: number
  path: string
  status: number | null
  reqSize: number
  resSize: number
  durationMs: number | null
  contentType: string | null
  state: 'pending' | 'receiving' | 'done' | 'error'
  error: string | null
  errorCode: string | null
  client: string | null
  note?: string
  /** The ids of the rules that changed this exchange, in the order they acted. */
  rules?: string[]
}

export type ProxyCa = {
  path: string
  subject: string
  fingerprint256: string
  validTo: string
  spki: string[]
}

/** One of this machine's addresses, as the sidecar ranks them for a phone. */
export type ProxyAddress = {
  address: string
  iface: string
  label: string
  kind: 'lan' | 'vpn' | 'virtual'
  isPrimary: boolean
}

export type ProxyPhase = 'stopped' | 'starting' | 'running' | 'failed'

export type ProxyStatus = {
  phase: ProxyPhase
  host: string
  port: number
  addresses: string[]
  lan: ProxyAddress[]
  runDir: string | null
  pid: number | null
  ca: ProxyCa | null
  error: string | null
}

/** One rule as the rules view shows it: the file's entry, checked. */
export type ProxyRuleEntry = {
  id: string
  name: string | null
  description: string | null
  enabled: boolean
  /** What it does, in words (shared/rules.mjs describeRule). */
  summary: string
  errors: string[]
  /** It holds a script whose code is not approved yet. */
  isUntrusted: boolean
}

export type ProxyRules = {
  file: string | null
  entries: ProxyRuleEntry[]
  /** Problems of the file itself (not JSON, wrong shape). */
  fileErrors: string[]
}

export type ProxySetupTab = 'browser' | 'ios' | 'android' | 'cli'

export type ProxyView = {
  mode: 'list' | 'detail' | 'setup' | 'rules'
  selectedId: number | null
  setupTab: ProxySetupTab
  layout?: 'list' | 'tree'
}

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    proxy: {
      flows: ProxyFlow[]
      status: ProxyStatus
      view: ProxyView
      filter: string
      wanted: boolean
      nextId: number
      notice: string
      emulators: string[]
      expanded: string[]
      rules: ProxyRules
    }
  }
}
